description: Land Acquisition - Kanatthagoda-North, Matara D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed information about a specific land parcel (lot number, extent, location, current use) being acquired by the government for public purpose (providing alternative lands to flood-displaced persons). The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition, property matters, and real estate transactions.
